name: Announcer
description: A visually hidden live region that re-announces a message whenever it changes.

anatomy.description: Visually hidden role="status" element with aria-live set from politeness and aria-atomic.
The message is emptied and then re-written so a repeated message is announced again.

dos: Keep one Announcer per message channel and update its message prop as state changes.
Use assertive only for urgent changes that must interrupt the user.
donts: Don't announce changes that are already visible and focused; that duplicates the information.
Don't mount a new Announcer per message; reuse a single region.

examples.title: Status updates
examples.description: The region clears and rewrites so a repeated message is announced again.

examples.title: Assertive updates
examples.description: Use politeness="assertive" only for urgent changes that should interrupt.

guidance.useWhen: State changes off-screen must reach screen-reader users.
guidance.avoidWhen: The change is already visible and focused; announcement would duplicate it.
guidance.behavior: The region clears and rewrites so identical messages re-announce.
guidance.responsive: The region is visually hidden and has no layout impact.

notes: Renders a visually hidden role="status" region with aria-live set from politeness and aria-atomic="true".
The region clears and rewrites the message so an identical message is announced again.
Reserve politeness="assertive" for urgent changes; polite is the default.

props.description: Text announced to screen readers; re-announced whenever it changes.
props.name: message
